subject: how a batch of 16 samples shrinks as some exit early at each layer's ramp instead of continuing

groups.why_chosen: Augmenting each layer of a DNN with a lightweight exit ramp lets easy inputs leave the model as soon as a ramp is confident, so a batch's effective size shrinks layer by layer instead of every input running the full network.
groups.what_to_learn: Running counts written on the arrows between repeated stages; an ellipsis to compress the middle; a dashed box naming the pre-existing part
